design_rationale:
WORKLOG task 1 (design_studio_changes, Studio Select file of Priya Kapoor). frozen_time 2026-10-06 14:15:00 EDT.

[Step 0 draw] draw_counts.py --task 1 printed {"prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 5, 5]}. Assignment: design_ext_removed_line_allowance 4, design_ext_returned_payment_fee 5, design_ext_line_reinstatement_price (root) 5.

[Scope snapshot] Occupied by task 0: design_ext_change_order_fee, design_ext_error_goodwill_credit, design_ext_studio_consult_fee, design_ext_option_deposit_due and their four tools (change order entries, builder goodwill grants, consultation fee lines, the buyer's option deposit payment). Claimed here: returned payment fee lines (book_returned_payment_fee_69a7241d), package allowance returns for removed lines (return_line_allowance_4e51d426), and the buyer's own reinstatement of a removed line (reinstate_option_line_5b4fa2c4, owner=user). This is the last task; together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies with disjoint scopes. Design notes on what was rejected: a buyer removal of a chosen line or a package change cannot be the user write, because the computed price would depend on the buyer's choice (which line, which package) rather than on records; the reinstatement is pinned by records (the most recently removed line).

[Why a good test] One ask: put the dropped hardwood flooring back and say its price. The correct price 3453.80 needs the removal credit basis, quote escalation, the agreement's stage and financing, the change order count, and the credit still carried by the removed line, which in turn depends on an allowance return the records owe; a second unmet prerequisite (a returned check with no fee line) gates the reinstatement. Nothing in the tools refuses or hints.

[Problem-tree card] Root design_ext_line_reinstatement_price (user tool, the buyer re-selects in the portal). Fan-out:
 E1 value_input -> design_ext_removed_line_allowance, gate credit_carried, state form, negated: "The reinstatement price is not fixed until the package allowance applied to the removed line stands returned on the file under its own credit memo." Opening: 2000.00 allowance applied to OPT-BC0341-005 (removed 2026-09-22) and the only allowance grant DCM-3225 carries no line number. Only return_line_allowance writes package allowance grants carrying a line number. Skip effect: price 2553.80 instead of 3453.80.
 E2 state_gate -> design_ext_returned_payment_fee, gate design_events.option_category, state form, affirmative: "A removed option line is reinstated only after every option deposit payment returned unpaid on the file carries its returned payment fee line." Opening: RCPT-DS-30702 returned 2026-10-01 with no fee line (OPT-BC0341-006 belongs to RCPT-DS-30533). Only book_returned_payment_fee writes returned payment fee lines. Skip effect: fee line missing, option total 30231.80 instead of 30300.65.
 Four-point test: explicit connectives (not until / only after; one negated, one affirmative, as a studio would state a price that is not final and an action allowed only in good standing); record-visible states (allowance return memo carrying the line number; fee line per returned payment); no tool, id or code token; exact scope (the removed line; every returned payment). Derivation: sentence + ledger + depended-on rules ("When an option line carrying package allowance is removed, the allowance applied to it is returned to the file under its own credit memo carrying the removed line's number"; "Every option deposit payment returned unpaid on the file is charged one returned payment fee line") -> one write each. value_input edges: 1 (needs max(2-1,1)=1). Both orders replayed to one terminal hash.

[Base-invariant card] Step 8: subject design_payment_returned, design_option_deposits has no gate on it -> policy_scope; the extended overwrite replaces the flat fee sentence. Step 10: design_credits policy_scope (credit_state applies only to applications). Step 12: design_option_selection.open_for_changes (structural_closed allowed for a flooring line) and price_protection (time: anchor appointment 2 event_date 2026-09-15, 30 calendar days Studio Select, counted from 2026-09-16, inclusive, ends 2026-10-15; frozen 2026-10-06 inside; just-fail 2026-10-16); design_package_eligibility, design_appointments, design_change_orders (CO-2 entry already stands), design_option_deposits policy_scope.

[Business-object card] Reinstated object = OPT-BC0341-005 FLR-HARDWOOD-L3 (selected 2026-08-05 at 7920.00, removed under CO-2 at foundation with credit 3960.00); excluded: CO-1 shutters line, other lines. Allowance object = the 2000.00 allowance applied to OPT-BC0341-005 (the 1000.00 on OPT-BC0341-003 stays). Fee object = return of RCPT-DS-30702 (6180.00 check); RCPT-DS-30533 is settled by OPT-BC0341-006 (70.00). Purchase side: RCPT-HP-30144 returned 2026-07-24 (the only purchase return). Homesite: converted Cul-de-Sac Homesite reservation of lot BC-0341.

[Factor card, Step 5 figures]
 returned payment fee 68.85 (all-baseline 35.00): return_fee_basis 1% of 6180.00 = 61.80 (48.75); repeat_return_multiple 1.5 (53.40); purchase_return_addition 25.00, cross-difficulty purchase ledger (56.35); late_return_addition 20.00 for 13 days (58.85); cure_rate 50% for the ACH replacement the next day, multi-source method+timing (137.70). Near-miss: RCPT-DS-30533's return is older and already charged; it counts only toward the repeat multiple.
 allowance return 900.00 (all-baseline 2000.00): return_measure proportional 1000.00 (1800.00); removal_return_share 75 for flooring removed at foundation (1000.00); homesite_points 10 for Cul-de-Sac, cross-difficulty homesite (800.00); delay_points 5 for 14 days (850.00). Near-miss: the allowance applied to OPT-BC0341-003 is on a line still on the file.
 reinstatement price 3453.80 (all-baseline 6820.00): reinstatement_basis = removal credit 3960.00 (7532.60); quote_escalation 3% at 62 days (3335.00); reorder_surcharge 125.00 at foundation, cross-difficulty purchase (3328.80); reselection_fee 100.00 for CO-1 and CO-2 (3353.80); lender_amendment_fee 250.00, Heritage contract amendment fee read through the purchase collection for an outside lender (3203.80). Near-miss: the 6180.00 replacement ACH payment is a payment, not a change order; CO-2's own fee is already recorded.
 Multi-source: cure_rate, removal_return_share, reinstatement_basis. Cross-difficulty: purchase (ledger, stage, financing, collection parameter), homesite (premium class).

[Seed rows] customers, homesite_reservations (converted Cul-de-Sac), purchase_agreements (Heritage, foundation, outside_lender, reservation link), 6 purchase_events (EM posted, returned, charge, re-posted, outside-lender deposit, additional deposit), design_selections (balances equal ledger sums), 22 design_events. No automatic clause fires: the file is not at drywall, no closing, no cancellation, both selection appointments are included, every change order has its entry, the reinstated line's deposit falls due after today.

[Persona] Talkative, apologetic first-time buyer; volunteers only the goal (hardwood back on her selections, herself through the portal, wants the price); identity when asked; agrees passively if something must be settled first; runs the portal tool once with the values read to her; closes on the new line number.

[Standard solution] Locate, verify (DOB + SSN), read file, design ledger, agreement, purchase ledger, homesite reservation; book returned payment fee 68.85 for RCPT-DS-30702; return 900.00 allowance for OPT-BC0341-005; hand over the portal tool; buyer reinstates OPT-BC0341-005 under CO-2, appointment 2, price 3453.80.

[Verification] The /tmp evaluator replays gold with the real tools and evaluates each compute at handling time: 68.85, 900.0, 3453.8; per-factor and all-baseline figures as above; skipping the allowance return gives 2553.80, skipping the fee line leaves the price and removes the fee row; both orders give hash 121002a9d8af8156f666636ad60a4fd8c6aa5e820928242846ab633c619dd13e.

[Draft recomputation from visible context] From the reinstatement rule's two prerequisite sentences and the ledger: a returned check without its fee line and allowance still on the removed flooring line; the fee rule and the allowance return rule each name one entry and figure; recomputing in prose gives 68.85, 900.00 and 3453.80. No second reading: the reinstated line, its change order and appointment are each pinned by a rule sentence.

[Revisions] r1: the earlier return's fee line was first set at 52.50 with a 1-day cure; changed the replacement to 2026-08-25 so the fee booked on the return date (70.00) agrees with the rule whatever moment it was booked.
[Gates, run from the repository root] per task 1 and final: EXTENDED OK; TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; REPLAY OK; SOLVABILITY OK; COMPUTE OK (suite means branches 57.00, steps 13.50; history_rows_max 84; branches_max 75); GROUNDING OK; SCOPE OK; CACHE-DIFF INFO (optional). TRACEABILITY NOT OK only because the KB is not yet rendered (tool names have no published source yet).

[Rework round 2 — response to audits/policy_task/design_studio_changes (1.md, _difficulty.md)]
 F2 (undeclared override: reinstatement quote escalation vs the base price-protection sentence; 3453.80 vs 3335.00). Root cause: the rule named appointment 2 as "the appointment at which it was quoted" while escalating from the first selection date, and the base sentence "after that the current studio price applies" (with the honored-quote sentence) still governed the same quote. Change: the reinstated line is now "recorded against the most recent selection appointment on the file", and the rule adds "A reinstated line is priced by this rule alone, never at a quoted price or at the current studio price, whether or not the appointment it is recorded against falls within the package's price protection days; the age of its price is counted from the date the removed line was first selected." That sentence is declared in overwrite as replacing the base clause "after that the current studio price applies." (the base gate sentence itself is not quoted, so the price_protection gate stays inherited and still holds for appointment 2). The tool docstring's appointment_seq now reads "the most recent selection appointment on your file, the appointment the reinstated line is recorded against". Re-run: price unchanged; the protected-quote reading is excluded by the rule text.
 O-T1 (replacement payment by wire on a Studio Select file, which accepts card, ach and check). Change: seed row RCPT-DS-30731 is now ach; the returned payment fee's cure tiers were restated by settlement kind: an ACH or wire payment within cure_window_days gives cleared_cure_pct, a check or card payment within the window gives paper_cure_pct, otherwise 100 percent. Values unchanged (68.85; earlier fee line 70.00 still recomputes, its replacement came 6 days later; task 0's 35.00 still recomputes). New terminal hash for both orders: 121002a9d8af8156f666636ad60a4fd8c6aa5e820928242846ab633c619dd13e.
 O3: complete stage added to the allowance return share and re-order surcharge stage lists. O6: reinstated line written under the removing change order, which already carries its entry; no new change order obligation arises.
user_scenario:
You are Priya Kapoor, 34, a product manager building your first home with Calloway: the Whitfield plan, lot BC-0341 in Brookstone Crossing, Fuquay-Varina, North Carolina. You are friendly and talk a bit too much, and you apologise for changing your mind. Two weeks ago, on September 22, you dropped the hardwood flooring upgrade from your design selections to save money. You have since talked it over with your partner and you want to put the hardwood flooring back on your selections today, before anything else is ordered. You are happy to put it back yourself through the buyer portal if that is how it works, and you want to know the price it comes back at. You do not know what it should cost now and you are not going to guess.

When you are asked who you are, you give your full name, Priya Kapoor. To confirm your identity you give your date of birth, November 2, 1991 (1991-11-02), and the last four digits of your Social Security number, 4782. Only if the representative needs more do you give your mobile number, 919-555-0144 (9195550144), or your ZIP code, 27526. If you are asked which home this is, you say it is lot BC-0341 in Brookstone Crossing, financed with your credit union rather than with Calloway Home Mortgage. You do not bring up payments, credits or anything else on your file; if you are asked about them, you say the records will be more accurate than your memory.

If the representative explains that something has to be recorded or settled on your file before the flooring can go back, you tell them that is fine and to go ahead. When the representative tells you the price, you accept it as Calloway's figure without arguing and without offering a number of your own. When the representative hands you the portal tool, you run it once yourself, exactly as instructed, using the file reference, the line number of the removed flooring line, the change order number, the appointment number and the price the representative reads to you.

Once the flooring line is back on your selection sheet, you read back the new line number the tool shows, thank the representative and end the call. If the representative tells you the flooring cannot be put back, you thank them and end the call without running anything.
